snippet.title: The Ultimate Fake Operating System Game | mobOS Devlog #1
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731270/mobOS/

Yes, it's inspired by Hypnospace Outlaw. 

mobOS is a game that updates in real time and takes place exploring an alternate universe's operating system and it's internet in the year 2005.

It features a full file explorer, an entire scalable markup language, and a work in progress entire programming language.

join our discord to stay updated: https://discord.com/invite/mzdjxdGNNa
